KOMEIJIKOISHI-BALANCE_SETTINGS.title: Balance Patch
KOMEIJIKOISHI-VISUAL_SETTINGS.title: Visual Settings
KOMEIJIKOISHI-ENABLE_ANCIENTS.title: Enable Ancients
KOMEIJIKOISHI-ENABLE_ANCIENTS.hover.desc: When disabled, this mod's custom Ancients will not appear in Acts 2 and 3. In multiplayer, the host's setting at run start is used.
KOMEIJIKOISHI-ENABLE_BALANCE_PATCH.title: Enable Balance Patch
KOMEIJIKOISHI-ENABLE_BALANCE_PATCH.hover: When enabled, selected Koishi cards use an alternate balanced set of values and effects. Restart the game for this setting to take effect.
KOMEIJIKOISHI-CARD_ART_MODE.title: Card Art Style
KOMEIJIKOISHI-CARD_ART_MODE.hover.title: Card Art Style
KOMEIJIKOISHI-CARD_ART_MODE.hover.desc: Choose which card art style Koishi cards use.
KOMEIJIKOISHI-USE_FUMO_CARD_ART.title: Use Fumo Card Art
KOMEIJIKOISHI-USE_FUMO_CARD_ART.hover.de: Supported cards use Fumo card art. Enabling this automatically disables Ancient-style card art.
KOMEIJIKOISHI-USE_ANCIENT_CARD_ART.title: Use Ancient Card Art
KOMEIJIKOISHI-USE_ANCIENT_CARD_ART.hover: Supported cards use Ancient-style card art. Enabling this automatically disables Fumo card art.
KOMEIJIKOISHI-PLAY_MORIYA_DANCE_FOR_ALL_: When enabled, every player plays the video when Moriya Dance is drawn. When disabled, only the player who drew the curse plays it. In multiplayer, the host's setting at run start is used.
